name: Z Filter
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' four filter models in one slot: a windowed resonator burst rung against a polarity-flipped pulse train and its integral.

controls.label: Model
controls.description: Selects the lowpass, peaking, bandpass and highpass filter models.

controls.label: Cutoff
controls.description: Sweeps the filter cutoff from below the note to ten octaves above it.

controls.label: Resonance
controls.description: Balances the raw pulse against the resonant ring, peaking at noon.

controls.label: Bend
controls.description: Bends the burst envelope from the flat stock ramp toward a sharp percussive attack.

outputs.aux: Its complement, so LP pairs with HP and PK with BP.
